applicant_utility.summary: Treat this as a living stipend rather than a fee waiver: the ANU page makes no claim about tuition, so you need a separate answer to who pays your fees before you commit. Because there is no scholarship form, your admission application IS the application, and the file is only complete once your referees have actually submitted - nominating them is not enough. If you are already an ANU candidate you must still lodge the 'Request for a current ANU student to be considered for a HDR scholarship' form or you will not be ranked in the round at all.
applicant_utility.best_fit: H1 or Honours-equivalent research graduates with a plausible ANU supervisor who can lodge a complete admission file weeks before the deadline.
application_readiness_checklist: Email your prospective supervisor or HDR Convener before lodging, so the research topic is settled before the file is scored
Nominate referees early and chase them; ANU warns to submit 2-3 weeks ahead because report requests only fire when you submit
Confirm every transcript, result and supporting document is attached before you lodge, not after
If you are a current ANU candidate, lodge the 'Request for a current ANU student...' form as well as your admission application
common_rejection_risks: Referee reports arriving after the scholarship deadline, which leaves the application incomplete and unrankable
Assuming the scholarship is applied for automatically once you are admitted, when current candidates need a separate form
Overlooking that international applicants hit 31 August, roughly eight weeks before the domestic date
Being an Industry PhD Candidate on a full-time salary, which is an explicit exclusion
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Canberra living costs beyond the $40,475 stipend, plus whatever tuition is not covered by a separate ANU RTP or fee source - the scholarship page itself publishes nothing about fees.
document_audit: Referees must be nominated through ANU's own request process; reports sent directly by email may not attach to your file
The two Conditions of Award PDFs published on the page are the authoritative terms - check which one applies to your commencement year
Current-candidate forms are easy to miss because they are a separate PDF linked only in the body text
alerts: The domestic Round 1 deadline moved from 31 October to 26 October 2026 because of a scheduled outage - do not rely on the older date
The award is annual and continuation depends on academic performance; only a 6 month extension is available
International-only benefits such as the Dependant Child allowance mean domestic and international packages are not identical
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Lodge the HDR admission application with 'Australia: ANU - Other Scholarship' selected, referees are auto-requested at submission, each College committee then scores and ranks all eligible H1 applicants in the round.

applicant_utility.summary: The strongest thing about this award is the automatic pairing: winning USYDIS drags the Tuition Fee Scholarship with it, so you should not budget for any tuition and you get Overseas Student Health Cover as part of the package. Watch the research-period structure rather than the calendar - your deadline depends on which research period you are commencing, so identify that first. Outcomes are staged, with offshore applicants finalising months after onshore ones, which matters if you are timing a visa or resigning from a job.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International research students who need tuition, health cover and a living stipend in one package and can commit to a Sydney HDR candidature.
application_readiness_checklist: Work out which research period you are commencing, then read the matching row of the Application and award timeline rather than the generic scholarship page
Submit your admission documentation through Sydney Courses first - the scholarship form alone will not be assessed
Draft research experience evidence using the University's own template and appendix guide, not a generic CV
Confirm whether a faculty-specific international research scholarship also applies to your discipline and apply for both
common_rejection_risks: Submitting the scholarship form but letting admission documentation slip past the same deadline
Missing that already-enrolled students follow the same deadline table, so continuing candidacy does not buy extra time
Being counter-ranked against applicants who have never held an HDR scholarship at the same level, which is an explicit preference
Treating the Research Period 1 and 2 round as still open after 11 September 2026
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs in Sydney beyond the $44,293 stipend, plus travel to Sydney and any costs outside the relocation and thesis allowances.
document_audit: Research experience evidence must follow the University's template and the accompanying information and appendix guide, or the panel has nothing consistent to score
The USYDIS and Tuition Fee Scholarship terms are separate PDFs - read both, since continuation conditions sit in the fee scholarship document
The HDR scholarship selection process document explains how ranking actually works and is worth reading before you write the application
alerts: Offshore applicants wait until 18 May 2027 for finalised outcomes for Research Period 3 and 4, 2027 - plan visas and employment around that
The companion tuition fee scholarship runs to 14 research periods, which is not the same as a fixed number of years
The stipend rate is indexed annually, so the 2026 figure of $42,754 will differ from the 2027 figure you budget against
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply for admission through Sydney Courses, submit the RTP application form by the round deadline, and the University issues outcomes from the date in the timeline table for your research period.
